questions.q: What does this Intermediate project assume is already handled from the Beginner project?
options: A finished performance-tuning plan
Overlook Medical Group's backup and restore plan
A completed security audit
A migration to a new Azure region
questions.explain: The Beginner project's backup/restore plan already exists and isn't revisited; this project starts fresh on a performance problem.

questions.q: Which two departments report slowness the same week, each assuming it's their own system?
options: Billing and Human Resources
Scheduling and IT Security
Billing and Scheduling
Billing and Marketing
questions.explain: Billing complains about slow invoice lookups; Scheduling complains about a freezing appointment calendar — the same week, independently.

questions.q: What do both departments' queries have in common that turns two complaints into one investigation?
options: They run against the same OverlookClinicalDB, at the same peak time, joining shared tables
They run on two completely separate databases with no shared tables
Neither one ever touches the Patients or Providers tables
They are both read-only reporting queries with no writes
questions.explain: Both departments query the same shared Azure SQL Database at the same mid-morning peak window and join back to the same shared reference tables.

questions.q: Why does the shared mid-morning timing matter before opening a single DMV?
options: It proves the backup plan from the Beginner project failed
It means the database must be restarted every morning
Timing never matters in performance troubleshooting
It's a clue that points toward shared peak-load contention rather than two unrelated bugs
questions.explain: A symptom clustering around one recurring time window is a real diagnostic clue, suggesting shared contention rather than coincidence.

questions.q: Which table does Billing's invoice-lookup complaint most directly point to?
options: dbo.Providers
dbo.Patients
dbo.Invoices
dbo.Appointments
questions.explain: dbo.Invoices holds one row per billing invoice — the table behind Billing's specific complaint, though both departments also share Patients and Providers.
